concerns.text: FR-004 (extract network reconfigurability metric) has no corresponding implementation task; the spec expects a task like `[FR-004]` to run Louvain, retry on failure and output a JSON metric, but the task list stops at T022 (which is absent).
SC-001 (percentage of subjects successfully processed through fMRIPrep) is not covered by any task; no task logs or computes this success metric.
SC-002 (re‑running metric computation with the same seed yields identical results) lacks a dedicated verification task; there is no task that runs the metric pipeline twice and asserts equality.

SC-003 (output CSV/TSV of p‑values) is not linked to any completed task; the only related task T028 is a unit test, while the implementation task to write `data/analysis_results.tsv` (e.g., T033) is missing.

SC-005 (generation of all required scatter plots and permutation‑test reports) is only partially covered: T034 creates plots but there is no task to save them as PNGs (T035) and no task to produce the permutation visual report (T040).

FR-003 (sliding‑window functional connectivity matrices) is only partially covered; while T021 computes the matrices, there is no task to persist them or aggregate them (e.g., T023/T024), leaving the requirement incomplete.
